scope: Native is_map_key_2/maps_is_key_2 outcomes through the existing bounded flatmap/HAMT lookup profile. Only erlang:is_map_key/2 gains a native registration here.
adaptations: Share checked lookup and failure classification with map_get/2. Found values produce true for membership; only an actual missing lookup produces false. Non-map operands retain the supplied value in badmap, not badarg.

Positively admit the exact is_map_key/2 native import in the nonallocating BIF group. Compiler-lowered map guards use existing map instructions. Unadmitted key comparisons/hash classes remain explicit profile refusals in both body and guard paths, not false results.

Charge map checking, search, key comparison and hashing through existing causal work helpers. Lookup does not publish or mutate a guest map, and does not collect the heap. Resource statuses remain distinct from missing-key outcomes.

Compiled fixtures and independent OTP reference cover flatmap/HAMT hits and misses, empty maps, badmap payload, guard behavior and nested tuple keys. Unsupported binary HAMT queries are valid in OTP but explicitly refused in the current native profile.

Nested flatmap lookup succeeds with both a full memory quota and an allocator denying all allocations: the tested path needs no scratch allocation. Tests do not claim to inject OOM into an allocation-free lookup. All work prefixes are tested on flatmap/HAMT hits/misses and HAMT guards. Shared-worker tests cover exact bytes, exact/one-below budgets, private reuse, peer survival and reclamation.
